女人愣了一下，嘴比脑子快：“采购部，商务专员赵小敏。”说完才反应过来——我为什么要回答他？

男人也跟着开了口：“鉴定部，马可。”

上官程微微颔首，目光在两人脸上淡淡扫过：“这次来，带的资金额度是多少？”

赵小敏委婉的拒绝：“这个....暂不方便透露。”话音刚落，便收到对方睨来的一眼。她心头一颤，几乎是下意识的说道：“五十万！初步申请了……五十万。”

“就五十？”上官程把这个数字在嘴里过了一遍，那语气，让赵小敏和马可的后背瞬间冒出了一层细汗。

溪山先前也出过红宝石，但品相都不算上品，目前价值最高的一块也就四十万。给出五十万的额度，还是因为这次上门业务是老板亲自嘱咐的，在他们看来已经是对一颗“疑似高品质”红宝石很给面子的报价了。

可面前这人似乎并不满意。

马可连忙补充：“当然，我们只是先来看看原石，具体报价要看鉴定结果。如果各项指标都达标，价钱好商量，好商量。”

上官程没再接话，指尖在扶手上轻轻叩了两下，不紧不慢的。

赵小敏额头上的汗越来越多。她忍不住偷偷跟马可交换了一个眼神——两个人都在对方的眼睛里看到了同一句话：这人到底是不是老板？

如果是的话，为什么啊？微服私访？暗查他们工作？体察民情？

那他们可得好好表现！不能出丝毫差错！

二人的神经越绷越紧，堂屋里的气氛越来越微妙，直到卧室那边传来动静。

“我弄好啦！”

霖多多踩着一双洁白的运动鞋，扎了个丸子头，换了干净清爽的T恤、牛仔裤。她略显急促的跑来，可当她看到堂屋情状时，却是脚步猛地一顿，愣在当场。

她走之前，明明是两个西装革履的专员坐在沙发上，阿九站着倒水，宾主有序。

怎么换了件衣服出来，画风全变了？

两个“贵客”不知什么时候站了起来，微微弯着腰，站姿拘谨得像是犯了错在挨训的小学生。而本该给人沏茶伺候的阿九，竟然大大咧咧地坐在沙发上，双腿交叠，微微仰头，那姿态——像极了老板在听员工做汇报。

“快起来！”霖多多冲上前去，一把拽住上官程的胳膊，“让你接待贵客呢！你怎么坐下了！”

赵小敏和马可的心同时一颤。下意识觉得：完了，这姑娘要挨骂！

毕竟在他们上官宝行，哪个不长眼的敢这样跟老板说话，保安早就冲上来把人扔到马路牙子上去了！

The woman was stunned for a moment, and her mouth was faster than her brain: "Purchasing Department, Commercial Specialist Zhao Xiaomin." After speaking, she realized what she was saying - why should I answer him?

The man also spoke: "Identification Department, Marco."

Shangguan Cheng nodded slightly and glanced at the two people's faces: "How much funds will you bring this time?"

Zhao Xiaomin declined politely: "This... it's not convenient to disclose it at the moment." As soon as he finished speaking, he received a look from the other party.Her heart trembled, and she said almost subconsciously: "Fifty thousand! I have initially applied for...five hundred thousand."

"Just fifty?" Shangguan Cheng said the number in his mouth, and his tone made Zhao Xiaomin and Marco instantly break out into a thin layer of sweat.

Khe Sanh has produced rubies before, but they were not of high quality, and the current one with the highest value is only 400,000.The quota of 500,000 yuan was given because this door-to-door business was personally ordered by the boss. In their opinion, it was already a very honorable offer for a "suspected high-quality" ruby.

But the man in front of him didn't seem satisfied.

Marco quickly added: "Of course, we are just here to take a look at the rough stone first. The specific quotation depends on the appraisal results. If all indicators are up to standard, the price is easy to negotiate."

Shangguan Cheng didn't answer anymore, and tapped his fingertips on the armrest twice, unhurriedly.

Zhao Xiaomin was sweating more and more on his forehead.She couldn't help but secretly exchange a look with Marco - both of them saw the same sentence in each other's eyes: Is this person the boss?

If so, why?Private visit via incognito?Undercover their work?Understand the sentiments of the people?

Then they have to behave well!Nothing can go wrong!

The two people's nerves became tighter and tighter, and the atmosphere in the main room became more and more subtle, until there was movement from the bedroom.

"I'm done!"

Lin Duoduo wore a pair of white sneakers, had her hair tied into a bun, and changed into a clean and refreshing T-shirt and jeans.She ran over in a hurry, but when she saw the situation in the main room, she stopped suddenly and froze on the spot.

Before she left, there were obviously two commissioners in suits and leather shoes sitting on the sofa. Ah Jiu was standing pouring water. The guests and hosts were in order.

How come you changed your clothes and your style completely changed?

The two "distinguished guests" stood up at some point, bowed slightly, and stood as stiffly as primary school students who had made a mistake and were being scolded.And Ah Jiu, who was supposed to be making tea and serving people, was actually sitting carelessly on the sofa, with his legs crossed and his head slightly raised. His posture was very much like a boss listening to an employee's report.

"Get up!" Lin Duoduo rushed forward and grabbed Shangguan Cheng's arm, "I asked you to receive distinguished guests! Why did you sit down!"

Zhao Xiaomin and Marco's hearts trembled at the same time.Subconsciously I thought: It’s over, this girl is going to be scolded!

After all, in their Shangguan Baoxing store, if any one who doesn't have the foresight dares to talk to the boss like this, the security guard will have already rushed up and thrown the person onto the curb!
